 RRB Nursing Superintendent Application Status 2026 OUT, Check Status at rrbapply.gov.in
 RRB Nursing Superintendent Application Status 2026 has been released on November 12, 2026 . Candidates who applied under CEN 05/2026 can check their application status at rrbapply.gov.in. The status shows accepted, conditionally accepted, or rejected applications. The examination dates have not yet been announced by the Railway Recruitment Boards.

 Important Instructions for RRB Nursing Superintendent Candidates 
 RRB Nursing Superintendent Application Status 2026 Out: RRB has released a notice regarding the RRB Nursing Superintendent Application Status 2026 on November 12, 2026 . Candidates can check the application status details for provisionally selected or rejected. Selected candidates will proceed to appear for the exam organised on November 23 and November 25, 2026 at the test centres located in India. 
 RRB Nursing Superintendent Application Status Notice PDF
 The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has issued an official notice for RRB Nursing Superintendent application status-related information on the website. Candidates need to log in to the portal to check the details regarding the application status. Selected candidates will appear for the CBT exam. RRB has mentioned the reasons for the rejected applications. Candidates should follow them carefully to avoid any future issues.

 Candidates can visit the login portal on the RRB website to check the status of the nursing superintendent recruitment applications. In case of rejection, the reason will also be displayed on the candidate's login account.

 RRB Nursing Superintendent Application Status 2026 Categories
 The RRB Nursing  Superintendent application status 2026 on the portal is classified into three distinct categories based on preliminary scrutiny:
 Provisionally Accepted: The application has passed the initial scrutiny stage. Candidates with this status are eligible to proceed to subsequent selection stages, subject to detailed document verification.
 Conditionally Accepted: The application is accepted subject to specific conditions. Candidates must check the conditions and remarks listed in their login profile.
 Rejected: The application has not been accepted. Candidates can view the specific reasons for rejection by logging into the official candidate portal.
 How to Check RRB Nursing Superintendent Application Status 2026?
 Candidates can check the outcome of their application submission by following these official steps:
 Visit the official application website at rrbapply.gov.in.
 Click on the candidate login section.
 Enter the registered mobile number/email ID and password.
 Submit the credentials to access the user dashboard.
 Check the RRB Nursing Superintendent Application Status 2026 displayed on the screen.
 Review the remarks or rejection reasons, if applicable, and save a copy for future reference.
 Also Check: RRB Nursing Superintendent City Intimation Slip 2026 
 What After RRB Nursing Superintendent Application Status 2026 Announcement?
 Application acceptance is strictly provisional and does not confer any right to appointment. RRB reserves the right to cancel candidature at any stage if false documents, incorrect information, or discrepancies are found. The selection process is fully computerised and based purely on merit. Candidates should beware of touts making false promises and rely solely on official RRB websites for recruitment updates.
 Important Instructions for RRB Nursing Superintendent Candidates
 Candidates should keep the following instructions in mind while checking their application status:
 RRB has completed the scrutiny of applications submitted under CEN No. 05/2026.
 Candidates can check their application status from November 12, 2026.
 The application status can be checked only through the official application portal.
 RRB has taken care while preparing the list of provisionally eligible candidates. However, the board can correct any typing, printing, or other mistakes.
 The candidature of all accepted candidates is provisional.
 RRB can cancel a candidate's application at any stage if any incorrect information, false documents, or other problems are found.
 Candidates involved in any unfair activity during the recruitment process may also face cancellation of their candidature.
 RRB will not accept correspondence from ineligible or rejected candidates.
 Candidates should check the official RRB websites regularly for the latest recruitment updates.
